name: opendatahub-alpinebits-destination-data-proxy
what_it_holds: Node.js REST proxy/reference implementation exposing OpenDataHub (South Tyrol/Alps region open tourism data platform) destination data in the AlpineBits industry-standard format, with OpenAPI spec; AGPL-3.0, maintained by NOI Techpark.
why_useful: Illustrates a working municipal/regional destination-data-as-API pattern (AlpineBits standard, OpenDataHub) that could point to other AlpineBits-conformant European destination boards' open data — marginal for ABNB (Alps region, not a major ABNB market) but relevant as a discovery method for gap 17 (open-data discovery tooling for tourism boards).
size_hint: small code repo, no bulk data committed
themes: Airport and city tourism dashboards scraped to CSV (NYC Tourism, Visit Florida, Las Vegas LVCVA, Orlando, Hawaii DBEDT, Destination DC, Visit California)
why_all: Illustrates a working municipal/regional destination-data-as-API pattern (AlpineBits standard, OpenDataHub) that could point to other AlpineBits-conformant European destination boards' open data — marginal for ABNB (Alps region, not a major ABNB market) but relevant as a discovery method for gap 17 (open-data discovery tooling for tourism boards).

name: Forecasting-Las-Vegas-Visitor-Volume-Time-Series-Analysis
what_it_holds: Time-series forecasting notebook for Las Vegas visitor volume; README states the dataset is 'publicly available at the Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority' research portal (external link) rather than a committed file — could not confirm whether raw CSV is checked into the repo itself.
why_useful: Second independent pointer to LVCVA visitor-volume data plus a working method (time-series decomposition/forecast) that could be adapted as a hotel-market comparator for ABNB NA nights; lower value than vegas-tourism-insights since the data itself may not be committed.
themes: Airport and city tourism dashboards scraped to CSV (NYC Tourism, Visit Florida, Las Vegas LVCVA, Orlando, Hawaii DBEDT, Destination DC, Visit California)

name: dvw-api
what_it_holds: Go REST API backing DBEDT's visitor data warehouse (paired with dvw-data-portal above). README is sparse/incomplete (no local-dev config, requires production DB connection); does not itself carry data files, but is the API layer over the same DBEDT/UHERO Hawaii visitor warehouse.
why_useful: Confirms UHERO operates a production API-backed Hawaii tourism data warehouse beyond the static DBEDT reports; if the live API/portal (data.uhero.hawaii.edu/dvw/) is queryable, it could give more granular or more current Hawaii visitor series than we currently hold.
size_hint: API server code only, no data files

name: kauai
what_it_holds: "Economic Dashboard for County of Kauai" — county-level Hawaii economic/tourism dashboard by UHERO; likely draws on the same DBEDT visitor warehouse at county granularity (Kauai is a distinct STR/tourism market from Oahu/Maui).
why_useful: County-level Hawaii breakout (vs. statewide DBEDT figures we hold) would sharpen the Hawaii party-size/occupancy series to a finer geography, useful if Airbnb Hawaii supply is concentrated in specific counties.

name: Tevasoft/sap-concur-connector
what_it_holds: Typed, async Python client for the SAP Concur API (Expense Reports v4, Travel, Users, Financial Integration, OAuth2). No data — it is a connector that only returns data for accounts with Concur API credentials (a corporate customer's own tenant); there is no public/aggregate Concur dataset behind it.
why_useful: Confirms there is no free, aggregate Concur/GBTA corporate-travel-spend dataset reachable via API without a paying corporate account — useful negative finding for the team (rules out a 'just hit the Concur API' shortcut for a business-travel-spend proxy).
themes: Corporate travel and business-travel data (GBTA, Concur/SAP, Navan public indices, conference calendars), MICE datasets
why_all: Confirms there is no free, aggregate Concur/GBTA corporate-travel-spend dataset reachable via API without a paying corporate account — useful negative finding for the team (rules out a 'just hit the Concur API' shortcut for a business-travel-spend proxy).
